entries.reading: The empire remembers its first victory. Yields rise where the banner first flew.
entries.flavor: First to fall under your banner.

entries.reading: Held ground pays. Garrisoned might flows back as yield, and the tithe keeps it honest.
entries.flavor: Take ground. Keep it. Tax it.

entries.reading: A warning in the ledger, not a prize. This bundle never ships: its pool promises more than it holds.
entries.flavor: Do not promise what the pool cannot draw.

entries.reading: Worn by specimens that survived their first field. A small edge, honestly earned.
Sworn and kept. The wearer holds the line a little longer.
Something was done that cannot be undone cheaply. The mark stays until the ritual is paid.
entries.teaser: Some deeds leave a mark the Hall will not hang.
entries.lockReason: Lift it with souls and matched essence, or carry it.
